content: Fortisip™ is a nutritional supplement in the form of a ready-to-drink milkshake, developed by Nutricia, specifically for the dietary management of malnutrition related to disease. It is formulated to provide all the essential nutrients typically obtained from a balanced diet. This product is intended for individuals who are unable to consume sufficient solid food due to various reasons, such as poor appetite or an inability to meet nutritional needs through regular food intake. Many individuals find it easier to drink rather than eat, and Fortisip helps to increase their overall nutritional intake. Fortisip is suitable as a sole source of nutrition for most individuals aged six years and older. It is particularly beneficial for individuals with cancer, as it can help reduce weight loss, improve strength, and support the body in coping with the effects of cancer and its treatments. Each 200ml bottle of Fortisip provides 300 kilocalories (1260 kilojoules) and contains proteins, as well as all the necessary vitamins, minerals, and trace elements required for a nutritionally complete diet. Fortisip is both gluten-free and lactose-free, making it appropriate for individuals with coeliac disease or lactose intolerance. However, it is not suitable for individuals with galactosemia, nor is it recommended as a partial source of nutrition for children under the age of three. Fortisip is available in a variety of flavors, including neutral, vanilla, strawberry, orange, banana, tropical fruits, chocolate, and toffee.
